entities.name: Havengul
entities.description: Major port city in Nephalia on Innistrad, known for trade, shipbuilding and a black market.

entities.name: Elgaud Grounds
entities.description: Small Avacynian church fort in Havengul, used as an execution site during the Lunarch Inquisition.

entities.name: Avacynian church
entities.description: Church with a strong presence in Havengul.

entities.name: Lunarch Inquisition
entities.description: Inquisition that used the Elgaud Grounds for executions.

entities.name: Herzag
entities.description: Corrupt merchant and Lord Mayor of Havengul.

entities.name: Jeleva
entities.description: Vampire who preys on the city from her mansion nearby.

entities.name: Gisa Cecani
entities.description: Occupies the Engelturm and dislikes Havengul.

entities.name: Geralf Cecani
entities.description: Runs Ludevic's laboratory in the city.

entities.name: Ludevic
entities.description: Owner of the laboratory, currently away.

entities.name: Engelturm
entities.description: Tower once home to the Flight of Goldnight.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion in which the Cecani siblings led the defense.

events.summary: During Avacyn's madness the Lunarch Inquisition uses the Elgaud Grounds as an execution site.
events.quote: the Elgaud Grounds were used by the Lunarch Inquisition as an execution site.

events.summary: During the New Phyrexian Invasion the Cecani siblings lead the region's defense; many citizens are killed.
events.quote: the Cecani siblings led the defense of the region

relations.quote: The Lord Mayor of Havengul is Herzag

Havengul is the largest of the three cities in the Innistrad province of Nephalia .
